verdict.rationale: Oyster documents a substantial public API. It covers creating and submitting EOR employments with country rulesets, verifying agreements for signature, provisioning benefits, and retrieving engagements, bonuses and allowances. It also supports reseller actions on behalf of customers, webhooks, client-credentials auth and developer sandboxes. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI, and many marketed UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent in the evidence: payroll runs, expense and time-off management, contractor payments, salary benchmarking and the cost calculator. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage of payroll, expenses, time-off, contractor payments and compensation data, independent corroboration of API completeness.
